newsitem.title: USA: QuickResponse names Hazlett as CEO.
newsitem.headline: QuickResponse names Hazlett as CEO.

text.p: QuickResponse Services Inc said Monday its board of directors had named Lynn Hazlett as president and chief executive officer of the company, effective immediately.
The company said Hazlett will replace Tania Amochaev, who has been appointed chairman of the executive committee of the board of directors.
Amochaev stepped down from the position for personal reasons, it said.
The company also said it had agreed to acquire Supply Chain Associates, a retail supply chain management consultancy operation founded and owned by Hazlett.
QuickResponse Services is a provider of electronic commerce merchandise and logistics solutions to the retail demand chain.
